name: Korg

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Rock Shield: Geçici olarak ek koruma sağlayan taş bir kalkan oluşturur.
abilityDetails.Instant Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Bleed Vulnerability: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Hasar önleme mekaniği, yüksek purify şansı, durdurulamaz+engellenemez erişimi var; orta vuruş veya özel saldırıyla vurulunca rakibe hasar verir. Enerji hasarlı veya fiziksel dirençli şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Rock Hard Thorns
While Rock Shield is active and Korg is struck by a Medium, Heavy or Special Attack that makes contact, [4,547.5 - 12,731.78] Physical Damage is inflicted to the opponent. Damage scales with Base Attack only. This ability does not activate if the opponent's hit deals Energy Damage and Mutant Champions take 25% less damage.
While Rock Shield is active, Korg has a [30 - 70]% chance to Purify Debuffs and gain one Rock Shield charge for each Debuff Purified this way.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Rock anatomy provides Korg immunity to Bleed, Shock and additional Critical Resistance but decreases his Energy Resistance by 20%.

abilitySections.title: Crowd Excitement
content: The crowd goes crazy when Miek makes an appearance while Korg is blocking an attack, increasing Crowd Excitement by 1 for 20 seconds. +2 on Well Timed Blocks. Only 6 Crowd Excitement charges can be gained through this ability.

The crowd dislikes cowards, cheering for Korg when opponents Evade or Dexterity his Basic Attacks, increasing Crowd Excitement by 3 for 20 seconds. Only 12 Crowd Excitement charges can be gained through this ability.
When Crowd Excitement reaches 6 or more, Korg becomes Unstoppable and Unblockable for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Miek expels fluids on opponents when hitting with a Heavy Attack, creeping out the crowd and consuming all Crowd Excitement to inflict Armor Break, reducing their Armor Rating by [1,027.47] for each Crowd Excitement charge for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive - Rock Shield
content: Korg begins the fight with 9 Rock Shield charges which are removed each time he is struck. An additional charge is removed when Korg's Dash Attack is interrupted by a Light Attack and if Struck by a Special Attack 3, all Rock Shield charges are removed instead.

While Rock Shield is active, powerful enemy attacks cannot deal more than 40% of the opponent's Base Attack Rating in a single hit. Special 3 Attacks cannot deal more than 120% of the opponent's Attack instead.
When all charges are consumed, Rock Shield is shattered and it takes between 11 and 15 seconds to reform. Each time Rock Shield reforms it starts with 1 less charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: If Crowd Excitement is greater than 1, this attack is Unblockable and cannot be Evaded.
The first hit refreshes Korg's personal Bleed Debuffs. If the Oppponent is suffering from 9 or more Bleed Debuffs, Korg's personal Bleed Vulnerability is also refreshed.
Each projectile hit inflicts an Instant [3,409.88] Bleed per Bleed debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, if Korg is Unblockable, refresh Korg's Personal Bleed Debuffs and inflict a non-stacking 50% Bleed Vulnerability Passive for 30 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
Each hit inflicts a [9,093] Bleed Debuff for 30 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks. Max stacks: 9.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Crowd Excitement goes up by 9 for 20 seconds.
